draft.subject: RevenueHunt — Japan rollout for skincare product guidance
draft.body:
Hi RevenueHunt team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company helping commerce software businesses develop Japan. We’re contacting RevenueHunt about product recommendation quizzes for Japanese Shopify skincare retailers, where matching routines to shopper needs is a focused introduction opportunity.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For skincare retailers facing staffing constraints, guided product selection could reduce repetitive pre-purchase advice.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: define the initial entry application, assess buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Japanese buyer evidence would guide quiz localization and deployment priorities. Can we help plan and execute RevenueHunt’s Japan rollout for these retailers?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
